notes: no written chain: the report opens mid-story with «وَ شَكَا هِشَامُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا» and al-Rida is in the scene (rule 6)
«قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَاشِدٍ» after the matn names a speaker, but whether he is the transmitter or only the teller of Hisham's words is not settled; no link added (rule 6)
